description: July 24 birthday meaning: Cancer or Leo cusp, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, July 24 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Cancer or Leo. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a July 24 birthday
paragraphs: With the Sun around one degree into Leo, July 24th is usually Leonine, though birth year and time can still place it on Cancer's side of the line. Either way, the blend of the Crab's care and the Lion's warmth suits birthday number 6, the number of home. Tradition pictures a big-hearted host who makes everyone feel like family.

By noon UTC on July 24, the Sun has normally reached roughly 1° of Leo. That places the date in the Leo decan that astrologers give to Sun, the first of three. Around July 21 to July 23, the Sun moves from Cancer, a water sign, into Leo, a fire sign. Born near that line, your Sun sign hangs on the exact year, time and birthplace, because the crossing does not happen at the same moment each July. A chart cast for your details will settle which side you are on. Astrologers often say people on this cusp combine lunar sensitivity with solar warmth and confidence. That blend can look like a protective host: someone who wants to be seen, and wants everyone in the room to feel safe.

sections.heading: Numerology of the July 24 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same July 24 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: July 24 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 24 is the 205th day of the year (206th in a leap year). In most years Virgo season is under way by August 23, 30 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 24 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. July 24 is also the birthday of Simón Bolívar (1783), Alexandre Dumas (1802) and Jennifer Lopez (1969).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 24?
faq.answer: July 24 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Cancer or Leo on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Leo. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 24 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 24?
faq.answer: By July 24 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 24?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a July 24 birthday are Simón Bolívar (1783), Alexandre Dumas (1802) and Jennifer Lopez (1969). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
